request.style: English, male choir, deep and resonant, solo tenor, harp, cello, timpani, solemn and majestic, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Bela son of Benjamin stands
With Becher and Jediael three
From Jacob youngest son came forth
The tribe of Benjamin we see

[Verse]
Ezbon Uzzi Uzziel too
Jerimoth and Iri five
Heads of fathers houses they were
Counted in the record given

[Chorus]
Mighty warriors strong and true
Twenty-two thousand thirty-four
Registered in the line of men
From the family of Bela

[Verse]
Iri stands among the five
A son of Bela by name
Part of the twelve tribes list
His place in history remains

[Chorus]
Mighty warriors strong and true
Twenty-two thousand thirty-four
Registered in the line of men
From the family of Bela

[Outro]
Heads of their fathers houses
Mighty warriors named Iri
Counted in the genealogy
Of Benjamin the tribe of God
